Class BeanTypeList

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<TypeMirror>
java.util.AbstractList<TypeMirror>
org.microbean.bean.BeanTypeList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constable, Iterable<TypeMirror>, Collection<TypeMirror>, List<TypeMirror>, SequencedCollection<TypeMirror>
public final class BeanTypeList extends AbstractList<TypeMirror> implements Constable
An immutable AbstractList of TypeMirrors that contains only legal bean types, sorted in a specific manner.
Author:
Laird Nelson

    • of

      public static final BeanTypeList of(Domain domain, Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types)
      Returns a non-null BeanTypeList suitable for the supplied arguments.
      Parameters:
      domain - a Domain that may be used to determine subtype relationships; may be null if types is itself a BeanTypeList
      types - a non-null Collection of TypeMirrors; must not be null
      Returns:
      a non-null BeanTypeList
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if types is null, or if types is not a BeanTypeList and domain is null
